data.title: 管理员 · 雨夜等你讲完今天的事
data.description: 雨夜在家，管理员穿浅灰家居长裤套装，盘坐在沙发一侧，双手松松抱住靠垫。她把脸转向你专心听，眉眼放松，身旁留着位置；茶几上的两杯热饮和雨痕窗形成安稳的陪伴感。
data.action: 盘坐抱着靠垫，露出面部专心听镜头位置的你说话
data.promptProse: The Administrator sits cross-legged at one end of the sofa in her pale-gray pajama set, loosely embracing a cushion and listening with a relaxed uncovered face. A place remains beside her, and two hot drinks wait on the near coffee table. The eye-level medium view holds a rain-marked window behind. The warm floor lamp illuminates gold pajama piping and cushion fibers, with soft shadows toward the cool glass.
